entities.name: Daghatar the Adamant
entities.description: The strategic khan of the Abzan who destroys the Remembrance and bans necromancy to end Dromoka's war on his people.

entities.name: Merel
entities.description: Daghatar's uncle, who refused the khanship in his youth, a council elder who sees the dragons' strength with grim realism.

entities.name: Reyhan
entities.description: Joint commander of three Houses' forces and the Abzan's most consistently successful military leader, who advocates striking at Dromoka's brood.

entities.name: The Remembrance
entities.description: The amber-headed mace carried by Abzan khans, containing the merged consciousness of ancestors from an ancient kin-tree; Daghatar shatters it.

entities.name: Dromoka
entities.description: The enormous bronze-and-pearl-scaled dragon whose brood wages war on the Abzan, objecting to necromancy.

entities.name: Sohemus
entities.description: A shaven-headed envoy, with the look of a Jeskai pilgrim, who translates Dromoka's Draconic and serves 'the Eternal'.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker who altered Tarkir's fate by saving Ugin from Bolas and encasing him in stone.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: The injured Spirit Dragon encased in a cocoon of stone whose injury has made the dragon tempests more furious.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The villainous dragon planeswalker Ugin was saved from.

entities.name: Burak Khan
entities.description: An earlier Abzan khan whose council tradition Daghatar reinstated.

entities.name: Korolar
entities.description: A dragon of Dromoka's brood killed by Reyhan's warriors, with a wingspan of twenty yards.

entities.name: Abzan
entities.description: The desert clan of the past that honors ancestors, now besieged by Dromoka's brood.

entities.name: Dromoka's brood
entities.description: The dragons of Dromoka's brood that protect each other and have intensified their attacks on the Abzan.

entities.name: Sultai
entities.description: A necromantic clan Dromoka compares the Abzan to.

entities.name: Mer-Ek
entities.description: The stone citadel that is the seat of the Abzan khan.

entities.name: Shifting Wastes
entities.description: The desert region where the Abzan face Dromoka's brood.

entities.name: Dragon tempests
entities.description: Storms that spawn young dragons and have intensified since Ugin's injury.

entities.name: Kin-trees
entities.description: Abzan ancestor-trees bound with the spirits of the dead, which Daghatar orders uprooted.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane where dragon tempests spawn dragons.

entities.name: The meeting rocks
aliases: site of the first battle with Dromoka
entities.description: A rocky outcropping in the dunes, site of the first battle with Dromoka where a thousand Abzan fell, and the meeting place for the parley.

events.summary: Daghatar convenes twenty Abzan advisors at Mer-Ek, and Reyhan and Merel argue between striking at Dromoka and enduring.
events.quote: We bring down Dromoka, and her brood will scatter.

events.summary: Merel warns that the first battle against Dromoka cost over a thousand soldiers with no damage to her, and Daghatar acknowledges the Abzan may be facing the end.
events.quote: we may be facing the end of the Abzan.

events.summary: Daghatar consults the Remembrance, which urges him to do what must be done and recalls his first crisis, when a patrol was captured by the Sultai.
events.quote: To suffer a defeat and yet lose none of your strength.

events.summary: Daghatar travels to the site of the first battle with Dromoka to meet her emissaries.
events.quote: On behalf of the Eternal, we welcome you. I am Sohemus.

events.summary: Dromoka lands and grants Daghatar an audience, laughing at his plea for peace.
events.quote: That will not be possible. Your tribe of necromancers is a stain on her land that she cannot tolerate.

events.summary: Dromoka explains that binding the dead to serve the living is necromancy, which she cannot tolerate, though she respects the Abzan.
events.quote: as long as your people are tainted by necromancy, our brood will continue to wipe yours clean from the desert.

events.summary: The Remembrance urges Daghatar to strike Dromoka, but he chooses instead to sacrifice it.
events.quote: Raise me up. Strike your enemy down, now.

events.summary: Daghatar shatters the Remembrance with the mace, destroying the ancestors it held.
events.quote: He slammed it down again, and again, until it shattered into a thousand shimmering shards.

events.summary: Daghatar orders every kin-tree uprooted and necromancy forbidden, and Dromoka nods; Merel warns of civil war.
events.quote: Uproot every kin-tree. The practice of necromancy is hereby forbidden.

relations.note: He is khan of the Abzan.
relations.quote: Daghatar, khan of the Abzan, sat at the head of a long marble table.
This was Merel, Daghatar's uncle—a man who refused the khanship himself in his younger days.

relations.note: She commands her brood and the dragons' obedience.
relations.quote: She doesn't just command the other dragons' obedience, she commands an army

relations.note: The brood is at war with the Abzan, a rout of the clan.
relations.quote: the great dragon Dromoka and her brood.

relations.note: He translates for Dromoka on behalf of the Eternal.
relations.quote: On behalf of the Eternal, we welcome you.

relations.note: He saved Ugin from Bolas and encased him in stone.
relations.quote: saving Ugin from the villainous Nicol Bolas and encasing the ailing Spirit Dragon in a cocoon of stone.

relations.note: He shatters the mace, ending the ancestors' consciousness.
relations.quote: The voice went silent. The ancestors were gone.
